title: Progress slideshow
section: Evidence updated 2026-10-21 · Phase 10: all-time magnetic field-line confinement in an exact non-axisymmetric vacuum stellarator field, proved via a verified explicit-constant KAM theorem (exact invariant torus within 1e-10 of a certified approximate torus; every field line starting inside stays inside forever). Earlier: one consistent axisymmetric plasma with certified local stability up to ignition; coil-produced stellarator confinement for one transit; finite-β non-axisymmetric equilibria (Mercier-unstable).
text: progress slideshow presentation latest run evidence vacuum fixture

title: Field lines of an exact stellarator field, confined for all time — by a verified KAM theorem.
text: field lines of an exact stellarator field, confined for all time — by a verified kam theorem. plasmalean is building a lean library for stellarator design. phase 10 proves that every magnetic field line starting inside an explicit torus around the axis of an exact non-axisymmetric stellarator field stays inside it forever, via a fully verified kam theorem with explicit constants. earlier phases joined confinement and burn temperature for one axisymmetric plasma with certified local stability, and certified a coil-produced stellarator field for one transit. all-time field-line confinement in a genuine stellarator field (vacuum model); one consistent axisymmetric plasma with certified local stability; coil-produced confinement for one transit.

title: Small assumptions. Reusable proofs. One candidate.
text: small assumptions. reusable proofs. one candidate. physical model laws are explicit hypotheses. derived mathematics and candidate certificates live above that small domain kernel. the public library separates all six layers. the last audit found only lean/mathlib's standard logical axioms, with no added domain axioms.

title: The foundations have executable proof content.
text: the foundations have executable proof content. simple models make the definitions testable before tackling three-dimensional plasma physics. these are compiled elementary results and sanity checks, not just declarations of future tasks.

title: From a numerical proposal to a proved bound.
text: from a numerical proposal to a proved bound. rational interval soundness and contraction arguments give small end-to-end tests of the verification path. exact arithmetic is connected to mathematical soundness theorems and explicit test fixtures.

title: Two circular coils. Precisely stated regions.
text: two circular coils. precisely stated regions. the first device-specific object is a calibration fixture with symbolic positive reference current i and permeability μ₀. its field model uses ideal filaments. closure, regularity, one-turn simplicity, source separation and the nominal midpoint field have proofs.

title: Margins for the same perturbed coils and currents.
text: margins for the same perturbed coils and currents. assume closed c¹ coils with position error ≤ 1 mm, independent tangent error ≤ 1 mm/radian, and independent current errors ≤ 1% of i. manufacturing and current errors compose into continuous field and clearance certificates, not just sampled checks.

title: Maxwell identities proved; interchange stability decided both ways.
text: maxwell identities proved; interchange stability decided both ways. the closed-filament biot–savart field is divergence- and curl-free off the coil. a sharp hardy inequality gives the suydam criterion with both sufficiency and an explicit unstable mode. a realistic screw pinch (a = 1 m, r₀ = 4 m, 5 t, ⟨β⟩ = 2/75) satisfies suydam everywhere with a 25% margin, and newcomb-reduced δw ≥ 0 is certified for every mode with 1 ≤ |m| ≤ 6 (wall at the edge); phase 2 extended this to every integer (m, n) with m ≠ 0 (screwpinchmodeshighm).

title: Two exact equilibria satisfy the kernel law J × B = ∇p.
text: two exact equilibria satisfy the kernel law j × b = ∇p. the current is computed as curl b/μ₀ from actual derivatives and checked against the unchanged kernel forcebalance class. p4 now has checked smooth instances at realistic field strength and β.

title: Symmetry plus Noether confines every slow enough orbit forever.
text: symmetry plus noether confines every slow enough orbit forever. canonical momentum m⟨k,v⟩ + qψ is conserved for any killing symmetry k; with speed conservation and an intermediate-value argument, orbits stay in a flux region for all time. p3 has checked full-orbit instances; field lines are confined by exact first integrals.

title: The remaining device work is explicit.
text: the remaining device work is explicit. the vacuum-fixture work packages remain, now joined by an equilibrium/stability track. a four-circular-coil, cnt-inspired architecture is a reference direction, not a certified design. reusable mathematics now spans fields, equilibria, local stability and symmetric confinement. no practical build or energization specification has been released.

title: A burning plasma that provably stays above 10 keV.
text: a burning plasma that provably stays above 10 kev. a reactor-scale 0-d d-t plasma (n = 10²⁰ m⁻³, 830 m³, carbon impurities with z_eff = 1.7) stays at or above 10 kev for all t ≥ 0 once heating beats losses at 10 kev. radial transport obeys a proved comparison principle, so a barrier profile bounds the temperature everywhere for all time. 13 new modules, including kernel laws for fusion power, radial transport and vacuum fields, each with sanity checks. an adversarial review caught a fuel-dilution error in the first m1 version; the kernel and the margins were corrected.

title: Every solution starting above the barrier keeps a 10 keV core forever.
text: every solution starting above the barrier keeps a 10 kev core forever. for the flux-surface heat equation with alpha heating, bremsstrahlung and ≈70 mw of deposited heating, a certified barrier profile bounds the temperature from below for all time. a 0-d burn window now follows from the ipb98(y,2) confinement scaling instead of ad-hoc confinement-time assumptions. 14 new modules. reviews found no soundness bugs and led to guards for shearless mercier surfaces, a non-vacuity witness for the obstruction, and clarified χ normalization and corner compatibility.

title: Every 3.5 MeV alpha born in the core stays in — forever.
text: every 3.5 mev alpha born in the core stays in — forever. in an exact equilibrium satisfying j × b = ∇p at 5 t and β ≈ 4.6%, every fusion alpha with energy ≤ 3.5 mev starting in the inner quarter of the flux, with any pitch, stays inside the plasma for all time under the full lorentz force. the margin is 1.5%: the same argument fails at 3.7 mev. 15 new modules and a recorded kernel change. three review passes: pressure consistency of the barrier, a finite-time boozer orbit structure, a kernel law excluding vacuous regular axes, and non-vacuity witnesses.

title: From 0.8 ms to 0.11 s — and a plasma equilibrium validated to 10⁻¹¹.
text: from 0.8 ms to 0.11 s — and a plasma equilibrium validated to 10⁻¹¹. iterating an oscillatory averaging lemma three times, with exact lie-derivative amplitudes and certified enclosures, extends passing-alpha confinement in a reactor-scale near-axis quasisymmetric field from 0.8 ms to 0.11 s. a slab grad–shafranov equilibrium with an exponential pressure profile is validated by the radii polynomial and proved to satisfy the kernel force balance. 12 new modules. reviews found an oracle factor-of-2 error (corrected; conclusion unchanged) and no soundness defects in the averaged-trapping theorem; its ≈ 6 min build is scheduled for a proof-term rewrite.

title: Confinement and heat, proved for the same plasma.
text: confinement and heat, proved for the same plasma. solovev_one_plasma: one exact field satisfying j × b = ∇p; every 3.5 mev alpha born in the core stays inside forever; every solution of the transport law starting in a certified band keeps a ≥ 10 kev core forever; and the plasma pressure never exceeds the equilibrium pressure plus an edge offset. 8 new modules and kernel change k2. a sub-agent report that claimed non-existent geometry lemmas was caught at integration; every cited declaration is now grep-checked.

title: No supplied geometry, no auxiliary power — and a genuine stellarator field.
text: no supplied geometry, no auxiliary power — and a genuine stellarator field. the one-plasma theorem now uses flux-surface quantities computed from the equilibrium itself. with quarter-kev reactivity data it certifies a high-q (q ≈ 40) band and an ignited band with zero auxiliary heating. separately, an exact rational vacuum field with two field periods and stellarator symmetry gives the library its first non-axisymmetric stellarator geometry. 13 new modules; review found no bugs (fine windows and geometry bounds independently recomputed). trapped near-qa alphas: turning points proved, non-resonance open — a real resonance exists in the band.

title: 95 toroidal transits, certified, in a genuine stellarator field.
text: 95 toroidal transits, certified, in a genuine stellarator field. for the exact vacuum field b = ∇φ + ¼∇h — non-axisymmetric, two field periods, stellarator-symmetric — every field line starting within ≈ 0.023 r₀ of the magnetic axis stays within ≈ 0.1 r₀ of it for at least 95 full toroidal transits. and the coarea formula closes the last stated link in the one-plasma theorem. 7 new modules; review found the certificate sound (exact margins, symmetry reduction and face coverage checked) and led to a local field-line version and fuller disclosures.

title: Stable on every surface; from coil error to confined field lines.
text: stable on every surface; from coil error to confined field lines. ideal ballooning is certified on every flux surface of the reactor equilibrium, axis to edge. for the exact stellarator field, a concrete closed filament reproduces the toroidal part to 2.5×10⁻⁶, and any coil set whose helical error on a bounding surface is below 6.5×10⁻⁴ (or 5.6×10⁻⁵) inherits 1 (or 10) certified transits. 33 new modules (many certificate cells). the ballooning certificate was rebuilt as a proof-term cover; the trapped-alpha cell checks still await that rewrite.

title: Finite pressure without axisymmetry — and all-time confinement from one torus.
text: finite pressure without axisymmetry — and all-time confinement from one torus. landreman's family-1 equilibrium satisfies the kernel force balance with finite pressure, is genuinely non-axisymmetric with a non-planar axis, and has all field lines closed and confined. for the exact stellarator vacuum field, any invariant torus traps every field line inside it forever. 3 new modules and two theory notes; a discovery-note error about the family-1 axis was caught and corrected by the formalization.

title: A certified approximate torus and the first KAM lemmas.
text: a certified approximate torus and the first kam lemmas. torus a — a 2-d fourier embedding with rational coefficients — solves the field-line invariance equation of the exact stellarator field to 10⁻²³ for all angles, and is a radial graph around the magnetic axis. the diophantine and cohomological lemmas of kam theory are proved with explicit constants. 7 new modules. constants budget for the kam step is an informal estimate until the frame and twist certificates land.

title: Real coils, certified field lines.
text: real coils, certified field lines. eight closed polygonal helical filaments plus a closed toroidal-field filament produce a field whose lines, starting near the axis, stay in the confinement tube for a full toroidal transit — proved from the exact biot–savart field of straight segments, a certified 6.5×10⁻⁴ frontier error and the vacuum maximum principle. 25 new modules; review found the coil chain sound (segment formula, corners, cover, symmetry, avoidance) and led to zero-margin and existence disclosures.

title: Error, frame, twist and small divisors — all certified.
text: error, frame, twist and small divisors — all certified. for torus a of the exact stellarator field: weighted invariance error ≤ 6×10⁻²² on a complex strip, a symplectic frame with explicit inverse bounds, twist ≥ 3/10, and diophantine constant 0.0687. a sheared finite-β non-axisymmetric equilibrium joins the library. 10 new modules completing the kam input certificates and adding family 2.

title: An exact invariant torus, and field lines trapped for all time.
text: an exact invariant torus, and field lines trapped for all time. a verified kam theorem turns the certified approximate torus (error 10⁻²²) into an exact real-analytic invariant torus of the stellarator field with rotational transform (75 + √5)/562. by the torus-trapping theorem, every field line starting inside it — at least 0.077 r₀ from the axis — stays inside forever. 17 new modules completing the kam route; the frame-transport assumption from part 3 is now derived.

title: Theory, techniques and a ladder of models — for confinement and for heat.
text: theory, techniques and a ladder of models — for confinement and for heat. each cycle develops theory, turns theorems into sound certificate checkers, and applies them to the next rung of a model ladder. every rung must prove properties of both kinds: confinement (g1) and temperature held above burn conditions (g2). phases 1–4 met their acceptance criteria in idealized models. the plan's status marks and progress log are updated after each phase.

title: The next run must leave evidence, not just a promise.
text: the next run must leave evidence, not just a promise. next: all-time confinement for a coil-produced stellarator field; field-line existence; a stable finite-β stellarator via stepped pressure across the exact torus; guiding-centre particle confinement in the exact field. the linked run records checked declarations, assumptions and validation. this slideshow is a summary of that evidence, not a new design certificate.
